name: Final Upload Extractor Freeze Marker

summary.architectural_boundary: Phase 4.4 is permanently frozen as the uploaded document extraction layer.
summary.output: Normalized UploadExtractionResult objects and upload extraction artifacts.

freeze_rules: Do not move website article extraction into Phase 4.4.
Do not add page classification logic into Phase 4.4.
Do not add semantic routing into Phase 4.4.
Do not couple upload extraction with semantic workspace learning.
Phase 4.4 must remain responsible only for uploaded document extraction and normalization.
Future document formats should plug into this extractor without changing downstream semantic intelligence.
